deadline.value: All materials (Graduate School application plus the INP supplemental application) are due November 15 (2026 for Fall 2027); late or incomplete applications are not considered.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the fall Ph.D. program is November 15. Incomplete or late applications will not be considered.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are neither required nor accepted.
gre_general.quote: The neuroscience graduate program does not require GRE scores or accept them in the application submission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE scores (including subject tests) are accepted.
gre_subject.quote: The neuroscience graduate program does not require GRE scores or accept them in the application submission.

supervisor.value: Students do 2-3 eight-week lab rotations in the first year and choose a dissertation advisor by the end of fall or mid-spring.
supervisor.quote: Participate in 2-3, eight-week research lab rotations with the expectation of choosing a dissertation faculty advisor and joining a lab by the end of the Fall semester or mid-way Spring semester.

funding.value: All admitted students are guaranteed a USD 40,000 stipend for five years, subject to good standing and availability of funds.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the INP are guaranteed stipend of $40,000 for 5 years provided they are in good standing and contingent upon satisfactory academic, professional performance, and availability of funds.

entry_route.value: Applicants from biological, physical, computational and psychological sciences are eligible; no specific courses are required beyond basic undergraduate science and math. Research experience matters most.
entry_route.quote: The program does not have specific course requirements, although completion of basic science and math undergraduate coursework is encouraged.

notes: Interviews invited in December. At least one recommender must be a research mentor.
